name: This Is Spinal Axe
summary: Ug’thok in Orgrimmar asks you to gather spines from the huge beasts of Thunder Ridge. He hopes to use them for an axe head as part of your smithing lessons.

sections.title: A smith’s idea
sections.body: Ug’thok wants five Weathered Spines and five Rough Grinding Stones. He thinks the spines may make a fine axe head, though Saru laughed at the idea.

sections.title: Tough material
sections.body: The spines prove tougher than Ug’thok expected, and crafting with them may be difficult. He plans to keep working on the design.

faq.q: Who is asking for the spines?
faq.answer: Ug’thok in Orgrimmar asks you to gather Weathered Spines and Rough Grinding Stones.

faq.q: What does Ug’thok want to make?
faq.answer: Ug’thok hopes to craft the head of an axe from the beasts’ spines.

faq.q: Where do the spines come from?
faq.answer: The Weathered Spines come from the huge beasts of Thunder Ridge.
He asks for Rough Grinding Stones along with the spines.

faq.q: Why does Ug’thok want the materials?
faq.answer: He wants to try making an axe head from the spines as part of your smithing lessons.

angles.text: As a smithing student, you help Ug’thok gather materials for an axe head he hopes to craft.

attribution: In-game quest text: This Is Spinal Axe
